in_sanskrit.name: मधुरा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Madhura is derived from the Sanskrit word 'madhu' which means nectar or honey. It is a feminine name that symbolizes sweetness, beauty, and pleasure.

in_marathi.name: Madhura
